title: PRD mps services
summary: Ledgerline PRD services mps_get, mps_save, and mps_search for retrieving, amending, and searching master schedule records on screen PRD-MPS-05.
body:
The `services-prd-mps` service group encompasses the Ledgerline ERP production module services used to query, list, and maintain master production schedule entries [^r1][^r9][^r15]. These services interface directly with [[screen-prd-mps-05|PRD-MPS-05]] to support master schedule planning across production lines [^r1][^r5]. All endpoints operate over HTTP POST, require valid session token authentication, and restrict invocation to authorised user roles [^r9][^r10][^r15][^r16][^r22][^r23].

## Services

### mps_get

Service `mps_get` (MASTER SCHEDULE GET) is a read service introduced in Ledgerline 7.0 that retrieves master schedule data for a specified item to populate the display grid [^r2][^r7][^r9]. It is executed on screen [[screen-prd-mps-05|PRD-MPS-05]] using function key F3 or via endpoint `POST /ll72/svc/mps_get` [^r5][^r9].

* **Required fields**: `itm_cd` (string) [^r7][^r11].
* **Optional fields**: None [^r11].
* **Errors**: Specific errors are [[err-mps-0001|ERR-MPS-0001]] (MASTER SCHEDULE NOT FOUND) and [[err-itm-0011|ERR-ITM-0011]] (ITEM NOT FOUND OR INACTIVE) [^r7][^r13]. Common errors include ERR-SEC-0001 (ACCESS DENIED), ERR-SYS-0421 (<FIELD> MANDATORY), ERR-SYS-0422 (UNKNOWN FIELD <FIELD> / BAD VALUE FOR <FIELD>), and ERR-SYS-0503 (SERVER BUSY, TRY LATER) [^r14].
* **Response**: Returns an envelope containing `rc` (`S | W | E`), `err_cd`, `msg`, and `data` [^r12].
* **Source file**: `04_service_definitions/production/mps_get.yaml` [^r9].

### mps_save

Service `mps_save` (MASTER SCHEDULE SAVE) is a write service introduced in Ledgerline 7.0 that commits new or updated schedule line requirements to the database [^r3][^r6][^r15]. It runs backend stored procedure `sp_mps_save` and is invoked from screen [[screen-prd-mps-05|PRD-MPS-05]] using function key F8 or via endpoint `POST /ll72/svc/mps_save` [^r5][^r6][^r15][^r21].

* **Required fields**: `itm_cd` (string), `week` (string), and `qty` (integer) [^r6][^r17].
* **Optional fields**: None [^r17].
* **Errors**: Specific errors are [[err-mps-0201|ERR-MPS-0201]] (QTY MUST BE > 0) and [[err-itm-0011|ERR-ITM-0011]] (ITEM NOT FOUND OR INACTIVE) [^r19]. Common errors include ERR-SEC-0001 (ACCESS DENIED), ERR-SYS-0421 (<FIELD> MANDATORY), ERR-SYS-0422 (UNKNOWN FIELD <FIELD> / BAD VALUE FOR <FIELD>), and ERR-SYS-0503 (SERVER BUSY, TRY LATER) [^r20].
* **Response**: Returns an envelope containing `rc` (`S | W | E`), `err_cd`, `msg`, and `data` [^r18].
* **Source file**: `04_service_definitions/production/mps_save.yaml` [^r15].

### mps_search

Service `mps_search` (MASTER SCHEDULE LIST) is a read service introduced in Ledgerline 7.0 that retrieves matching master schedule lines across production lines and planning horizons [^r1][^r4][^r22]. It is invoked from screen [[screen-prd-mps-05|PRD-MPS-05]] using F2 or Enter, or via endpoint `POST /ll72/svc/mps_search` [^r1][^r5][^r22].

* **Required fields**: None [^r24].
* **Optional fields**: `itm_cd` (string), `week` (string), `qty` (integer), and `status` (string) [^r8][^r24].
* **Errors**: Specific errors defined are [[err-mps-0201|ERR-MPS-0201]] (QTY MUST BE > 0) and [[err-itm-0011|ERR-ITM-0011]] (ITEM NOT FOUND OR INACTIVE) [^r26].
* **Response**: Returns an envelope containing `rc` (`S | W | E`), `err_cd`, `msg`, and `data` [^r25].
* **Source file**: `04_service_definitions/production/mps_search.yaml` [^r22].

## Versions and conflicts

* **mps_get request parameters**: The service definition specification mandates only `itm_cd` [^r11], whereas the user manual states that `mps_get` takes both `ITEM CD` and `WEEK` to populate schedule details [^r2].
* **mps_search error catalogue**: The service definition YAML lists [[err-mps-0201|ERR-MPS-0201]] (QTY MUST BE > 0) under specific errors for read service `mps_search` [^r26], matching the write validation error defined for `mps_save` [^r19].

## See also

* [[err-mps-0001|ERR-MPS-0001 Missing Mandatory Field or Invalid Format in MPS]]
* [[err-mps-0201|ERR-MPS-0201 Master Schedule Line Locked Against Modification]]
* [[err-itm-0011|ERR-ITM-0011 ITEM NOT FOUND OR INACTIVE]]

r1.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r1.quote: To locate existing records across a broad range of production lines, leave the selection parameters clear or specify a known identifier, then press the button corresponding to service mps_search.

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r2.loc_text: p. 27, Creating or amending schedule lines
r2.quote: enter the known product code into ITEM CD and the relevant calendar period into WEEK, then press the button associated with service mps_get.

r3.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r3.loc_text: p. 27, Creating or amending schedule lines
r3.quote: Ledgerline invokes the MASTER SCHEDULE SAVE service. The software commits the transaction to the database, recalculates associated production horizon flags

r4.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r4.loc_text: p. 27, Creating or amending schedule lines
r4.quote: Ledgerline ERP 7.2 calls the MASTER SCHEDULE LIST service, returning all matching scheduled lines to the main display grid.

r5.quote: Save F8 mps_save Get F3 mps_get Search F2/Enter mps_search

r6.quote: mps_save MASTER SCHEDULE SAVE Kind: write. Screen: PRD-MPS-05. Since: 7.0. Procedures: sp_mps_save.

r7.quote: mps_get MASTER SCHEDULE GET Kind: read. Screen: PRD-MPS-05. Since: 7.0. Procedures: none.

r8.quote: mps_search MASTER SCHEDULE LIST Kind: read. Screen: PRD-MPS-05. Since: 7.0. Procedures: none.

r9.quote: service: mps_get title: MASTER SCHEDULE GET module: PRD kind: read screen: PRD-MPS-05 since: "7.0" endpoint: POST /ll72/svc/mps_get

r10.quote: auth: session token in header X-LL-Session; the user's role must allow the service

r11.quote: request: fields: - {name: itm_cd, type: str, required: true, desc: ITM CD}

r12.quote: envelope: {rc: "S | W | E", err_cd: "error code when rc is E", msg: "short message in capitals", data: "result"}

r13.quote: - {code: ERR-MPS-0001, msg: MASTER SCHEDULE NOT FOUND} - {code: ERR-ITM-0011, msg: ITEM NOT FOUND OR INACTIVE}

r14.quote: - {code: ERR-SEC-0001, msg: ACCESS DENIED} - {code: ERR-SYS-0421, msg: "<FIELD> MANDATORY"} - {code: ERR-SYS-0422, msg: "UNKNOWN FIELD <FIELD> / BAD VALUE FOR <FIELD>"} - {code: ERR-SYS-0503, msg: "SERVER BUSY, TRY LATER"}

r15.quote:
service: mps_save
title: MASTER SCHEDULE SAVE
module: PRD
kind: write
screen: PRD-MPS-05
since: "7.0"
endpoint: POST /ll72/svc/mps_save

r16.quote: auth: session token in header X-LL-Session; the user's role must allow the service

r18.quote: envelope: {rc: "S | W | E", err_cd: "error code when rc is E", msg: "short message in capitals", data: "result"}

r19.quote:
- {code: ERR-MPS-0201, msg: "QTY MUST BE > 0"}
  - {code: ERR-ITM-0011, msg: ITEM NOT FOUND OR INACTIVE}

r22.quote: service: mps_search title: MASTER SCHEDULE LIST module: PRD kind: read screen: PRD-MPS-05 since: "7.0" endpoint: POST /ll72/svc/mps_search

r23.quote: auth: session token in header X-LL-Session; the user's role must allow the service

r24.quote: fields: - {name: itm_cd, type: str, required: false, desc: ITEM CD} - {name: week, type: str, required: false, desc: WEEK} - {name: qty, type: int, required: false, desc: QTY} - {name: status, type: str, required: false, desc: STATUS}

r25.quote: envelope: {rc: "S | W | E", err_cd: "error code when rc is E", msg: "short message in capitals", data: "result"}

r26.quote: errors: - {code: ERR-MPS-0201, msg: "QTY MUST BE > 0"} - {code: ERR-ITM-0011, msg: ITEM NOT FOUND OR INACTIVE}

conflicts.today: In 04_service_definitions/production/mps_get.yaml, mps_get requires only mandatory field itm_cd
conflicts.other: In MAN-PRD-72 v7.2.3 (p. 27), mps_get takes both ITEM CD and WEEK to populate scheduled quantity and status

conflicts.today: In 04_service_definitions/production/mps_search.yaml, mps_search returns specific errors ERR-MPS-0201 and ERR-ITM-0011
conflicts.other: In 04_service_definitions/production/mps_save.yaml and MAN-SVC-72, ERR-MPS-0201 ('QTY MUST BE > 0') is defined as a validation error on write operations, whereas mps_search is a read service
